title: Executable Vandermonde Construction Work
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, set $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. The executable Vandermonde construction work is the sum of the binary-field preprocessing work at degree $\ell$ and the binary-constructor traversal work with row budget equal to the power-row work at degree $\ell$ and exponent parameter $k-1$, plus one, on the list $0,1,\ldots,n-1$.
caveat: The snippet does not include informal definitions of the component work functions, so their arguments and combination are rendered literally.
